cards.card_text: The threshing floors will be ___ of grain, and the vats will ___ with new wine and oil.
cards.verse_text: The threshing floors will be full of grain, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.
cards.snippet: The threshing floors will be full of grain, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.

cards.card_text: In this harvest picture, why do the wine vats overflow?
cards.verse_text: Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full; the wine vats overflow because their wickedness is great.
cards.snippet: Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full; the wine vats overflow because their wickedness is great.

cards.card_text: A man plants a vineyard, puts a wall around it, digs a wine vat and builds a watchtower, and friend, that's not a vineyard anymore, that's a FORTRESS.
cards.verse_text: He put a wall around it, dug a wine vat, and built a watchtower.
cards.snippet: He put a wall around it, dug a wine vat, and built a watchtower.
